review: 702.167a-2: B controlled no land, so the spell_on_stack variant's Shock was unreachable; gave B an untapped Mountain in the setup and had the delta tap it for Shock.

scenarios.title: Craft exiles the permanent and the materials as a cost, then returns the card transformed

setup.notes: Braided Net is the front face of a double-faced card; its back face is Braided Quipu. Craft is {1}{U} with one other artifact as material.

decisions: A activates the craft ability of Braided Net, paying {1}{U} with both Islands and choosing Short Sword as the material.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: materials_present
variants.expected: Braided Net and Short Sword are exiled as the cost. When the ability resolves, the card returns to the battlefield transformed as Braided Quipu under A's control.

variants.label: no_material
variants.delta: A controls no Short Sword; there is no other artifact on A's battlefield or in A's graveyard.
variants.expected: The craft ability cannot be activated because its material cannot be exiled. Braided Net stays on the battlefield untransformed and both Islands stay untapped.

scenarios.title: Craft can be activated only as a sorcery

setup.notes: In the base the stack is empty and A has priority.

decisions: A considers activating the craft ability of Braided Net, paying {1}{U} and exiling Short Sword as the material.

variants.label: beginning_of_combat
variants.delta: The step is beginning_of_combat instead of main1.
variants.expected: Activating craft is not legal: it is not a main phase.

variants.label: spell_on_stack
variants.delta: B has cast Shock targeting A, tapping B's Mountain; Shock is on the stack and A has priority.
variants.expected: Activating craft is not legal: the stack is not empty.

variants.label: opponents_turn
variants.delta: B is the active player instead of A.
variants.expected: Activating craft is not legal: it is not A's turn.

scenarios.title: A craft material described by type alone can be a permanent or a graveyard card of that type

setup.notes: Braided Net's craft is 'with artifact', without the word 'card'. Short Sword is an artifact.

decisions: A considers activating the craft ability of Braided Net, paying {1}{U} and exiling Short Sword as the material.

variants.label: permanent_you_control
variants.expected: Activating craft is legal: Short Sword on the battlefield under A's control is a legal material.

variants.label: card_in_your_graveyard
variants.delta: Short Sword is in A's graveyard instead of on A's battlefield.
variants.expected: Activating craft is legal: the artifact card in A's graveyard is a legal material.

variants.label: card_in_hand
variants.delta: Short Sword is in A's hand instead of on A's battlefield.
variants.expected: Activating craft is not legal: a card in hand is neither a permanent nor a card in a graveyard.

variants.label: opponents_permanent
variants.delta: Short Sword is on B's battlefield instead of A's.
variants.expected: Activating craft is not legal: the material must be a permanent A controls or a card in A's graveyard.

scenarios.title: An ability of the crafted permanent counts only the cards exiled to pay its craft cost

setup.notes: Altar of the Wretched is the front face of a double-faced card; its back face is Wretched Bonemass, whose power and toughness equal the total power of the exiled cards used to craft it. Craft is {2}{B}{B} with one or more other creatures. The stack is empty and A has priority.

decisions: A activates the craft ability of Altar of the Wretched with X = 1, paying {2}{B}{B} with the four Swamps and choosing Grizzly Bears as the material.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: two_power_material
variants.expected: Altar of the Wretched and Grizzly Bears are exiled as the cost. Wretched Bonemass enters the battlefield under A's control as a 2/2.

variants.label: three_power_material
variants.delta: The material is Hill Giant (3/3) instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Wretched Bonemass enters the battlefield as a 3/3.

variants.label: unrelated_exiled_card
variants.delta: A's exile zone already contains a Hill Giant, exiled earlier by an unrelated effect.
variants.expected: Wretched Bonemass enters the battlefield as a 2/2: the Hill Giant already in exile was not exiled to pay the craft cost and is not counted.

scenarios.forge_notes: The crafted card itself (Altar of the Wretched) should not count among the exiled cards used to craft; verify Forge's ExiledWith on Wretched Bonemass agrees.
